subject: QMon handoff + staging safeguards for Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QMon: prompt set delivery and canary/rollback plan for Acme Health

Hi Ava and team,

Following today's onboarding sync with Samantha and Acme Health infra, I'm sending the initial QMon handoff package and a recommended staging/canary safeguard so implementation has clear guardrails. Attached: qmon-promptset-v1.csv (seed prompts from Acme), eval-harness-integration-spec.md (integration checklist).

Goals for this thread:
- Confirm eval harness integration points (webhook vs. pull) and owner
- Agree canary policy and rollback triggers for the first 2 weeks of production traffic
- Assign prompt-set ownership and create a cadence for prompt regression runs

Proposed immediate actions (this week):
1) Engineering: validate eval-harness ingestion endpoint and sample run (owner: Dylan) — target Fri EOD
2) CS: label seed prompts in the CSV into the stability/semantic buckets and add 10 negative samples (owner: Grace) — target Thu EOD
3) PM/Onboard: enable staging canary at 1% traffic for first 24h, then 5% for next 48h if no regression alerts (owner: Ava)

Suggested canary triggers (draft):
- Automatic rollback if any of the following within a 30-minute window:
  * increase in top-1 hallucination rate > 5 percentage points vs baseline
  * drop in rubric score mean by > 0.08 (on 0-1 scale)
  * error/timeout rate > 1%
- Manual review for smaller regressions; CS to own human-in-the-loop check.

Please reply with any changes. If we can lock the integration approach, I'll create the HubSpot checklist and drop the Drive link.

Thanks,
Marissa

Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — quick technical notes/questions:

On Thu, Mar 4, 2027 at 09:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Following today's onboarding sync with Samantha and Acme Health infra, I'm sending the initial QMon handoff package and a recommended staging/canary safeguard so implementation has clear guardrails. Attached: qmon-promptset-v1.csv (seed prompts from Acme), eval-harness-integration-spec.md (integration checklist).
> 
> Proposed immediate actions (this week):
> 1) Engineering: validate eval-harness ingestion endpoint and sample run (owner: Dylan) — target Fri EOD

Couple of clarifications so I can scope the work:
- Eval harness integration: do we expect Acme infra to POST to our ingestion webhook (push) or do we pull logs/payloads from their S3? If push, we'll need a short-lived token & example payload.
- Canary traffic routing: Redwood runtime supports percentage-based splits, but the exact enforcement of rollback will depend on whether the canary is served on the same model table or a pinned variant. Recommend pinning to a model variant so we can instant-fallback.
- Metrics: where will the rubric scores come from? Are we running the eval harness inside Redwood (server-side) or will Acme provide annotated scores? If we run it, we need the evaluation job to complete within 5 minutes of generation to be actionable for 1% traffic.

Proposed minimal acceptance tests for Friday:
- Endpoint accepts sample payload, returns 200, and manifests matching schema in eval-harness spec
- One end-to-end eval run on 50 prompts from qmon-promptset-v1.csv with rubric calculation output

I'm good with the rollback triggers but need to confirm whether the rubric calculation is automated or hand-annotated for the first run.

- Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QMon: prompt set delivery and canary/rollback plan for Acme Health

Thanks — adding the CS perspective and a slightly more prescriptive canary playbook.

On Thu, Mar 4, 2027 at 11:03 AM Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Couple of clarifications so I can scope the work:
> - Eval harness integration: do we expect Acme infra to POST to our ingestion webhook (push) or do we pull logs/payloads from their S3? If push, we'll need a short-lived token & example payload.

Acme confirmed during the call they will POST payloads from their staging environment to our webhook for real-time scoring. They also offered S3 export as a fallback. For the pilot, let's do both: accept POSTs and support a daily S3 batch if POSTs fail.

Draft canary playbook (for implementation handbook):
1) Staging preflight (owner: Dylan) — run eval harness on 200 samples from qmon-promptset-v1.csv, ensure rubric mean >= baseline -0.03 and no catastrophic hallucination cases in top-10 failures.
2) Canary day 0 (owner: Ava) — route 1% of traffic to the new variant, collect eval harness results in 1h windows. If rubric mean delta <= 0.03 and error rate <= 0.5%, continue to 5% after 24h.
3) Canary day 2 (owner: Ava + CS) — at 5% for 48h, automated checks run every 30m. If any automated trigger fires, auto-fallback to previous variant and open incident. If not, schedule a manual QA review and roll to 25%.
4) Rollback steps (owner: Dylan + Runtime Oncall) — instant pin back to previous variant, capture KV cache snapshot if applicable, notify CS and infra, and run a fast postmortem within 24h.

I added a short list of quick sanity checks for CS to run during the canary: smoke prompts that exercise privacy-sensitive fields, billing-sensitive flows, and highest-latency prompts. We'll track these in the Drive doc.

I'll add negative examples to the prompt csv by EOD and create a short Loom to show the S3 schema.

- Grace
Grace O'Connor
Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference

- Grace: thanks for the prescriptive playbook. Update the Drive doc with the three smoke prompts (privacy, billing, latency) and tag the negative examples you add.
- Marissa: I'll create the HubSpot task list and add links to the Drive folder + the rollback-playbook.pdf (attached). I'll also schedule the first canary window: Mon 2027-03-08 10:00 - 14:00 PT (1% traffic).

Deliverables & owners: 
- eval webhook sample payload & token (Dylan) — due 2027-03-05 EOD
- updated promptset with negative examples (Grace) — due 2027-03-05 EOD
- HubSpot checklist + Drive links (Ava) — due 2027-03-05 EOD
- Rollback playbook reviewed and attached for runtime oncall (Ava + Dylan) — due 2027-03-07 EOD

If no objections, I'll send the final hubspot checklist and confirm the canary schedule with Acme tomorrow morning.
